answer: Each identity stakes 160 POA to mount one quartz crystal lens on the shared jetty, cut so dawn light through it paints a course line on their own moored boat's sail, keyed to their first job receipt; at dawn the owner sails the boat out through the jetty gate along that line while two neighbors watch from the jetty, and a forged lens bends the line, the 160 POA kept and the owner barred five epochs. Ten clones need ten lenses, ten sails and ten separate dawn departures, 1,600 POA in all, no lens, sail or departure shared or reused.
